About

Ethos is an AI-driven platform that matches individuals with opportunities. It uses AI to scan hundreds of millions of profiles and match clients with the most relevant experts for insight-driven calls. The platform streamlines the entire process from booking to communication and compensation, making it equitable for clients and experts. While currently focused on expert calls, Ethos is expanding to match advisors with startups, speakers with events, and talent with employers.
